passages.provision_quote: A male, based on a student's biological sex at birth in accordance with the student's genetics and reproductive biology, may not participate on an athletic team or sport designated under this section as being a female, women's, or girls' athletic team or sport.

rows.reasoning: King co-authored HB 1041 (2022) and voted Yea on the May 24, 2022 override of the veto of the enrolled act, a single-subject school-sports bill whose operative section says a male "may not participate on an athletic team or sport designated under this section as being a female, women's, or girls' athletic team or sport." That is the rung requiring transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth; the rung banning all transgender athletes from any organized sports is excluded, because the act only designates teams and bars males from girls' teams.
